tei:titleStmt.tei:title: תַּֽמּוּ חֲלוֹמוֹתֵֽינוּ
Tamu Ḥalomotenu, a seliḥah for Yitsḥaq Rabin by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

tei:div.tei:head: Tamu Ḥalomotenu, a seliḥah for Yitsḥaq Rabin by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

tei:lg.tei:l: Our dreams died in bloodshed
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
Vanity and waste’s guards abandoned their mercy
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
The elders saw and were afraid
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
“Call a fast!” I shouted, but none called
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
The righteous were killed without number
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
The savages rejoiced with the shofar blast
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
Thus we fast on the day after remembrance
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
Forgive this stubborn people from judgment in rage and anger!
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
Villains stood up among the holy
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
From that era to this one, such people exist
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
Learn, please, fools, where hatred leads —
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
Destruction and devastation that no eye has seen!
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
Judah despaired of holding its inheritance
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
Terror and fear overtook its governance
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
Grevious are the sins of the party of Ben Netanyahu
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
Remember Yitzḥaq like the memory of Gedalyahu!
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
And the religion that Yishmael the murderer twisted
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
Was reduced, and no Yoḥanan ben Kareaḥ
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
Judge of orphans, you saw the slaughter
on the day the overseer of Israel was murdered.
Now too, see! Deny praise to murderers!
on the day of murder in Kings of Israel square.
Blessed be the avenger of Your servants’ spilt blood
on the day You distinguished us from the rebels of Israel.
I ask for peace in the merit of Your officer
on the day of remembering the minister of peace of Israel.

tei:note.tei:p: Now known as Rabin Square, the location in Tel Aviv where Rabin was assassinated.
Tzom Gedalyahu occurs the day afterRosh haShanah, traditionally also known as the Day of Remembrance.
Yishmael ben Netanyahu, who murdered Gedalyah along with ten followers, Jeremiah 41:1. Definitely not a reference to any modern political figures.
Again referring to Yishmael ben Netanyahu.
Jeremiah 40:13-16 — Yoḥanan ben Kareaḥ tried to warn Gedalyahu about Yishmael ben Netanyahu’s conspiracy ahead of time.
A pun on ‘rabin’ (officer) and ‘Rabin’ (the last name of Yitzḥaq Rabin)
Isaiah 9:5, a phrase used for a preace-bringing figure.
